# GraphQL Introspection Exposure Checker

> Free tool: sends one real introspection query to a GraphQL endpoint URL you choose and reports whether introspection is enabled -- exposing every query, mutation, and type name, including ones no client links to.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
